prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE finished pixel-art final victory illustration for the Game Boy Color adventure Negro Matapacos. It shows the president giving Negro Matapacos a gold medal after the students have been rescued, at Palacio de La Moneda in Santiago.
Reference image: the supplied campus cutscene is the definitive reference for the DOG'S IDENTITY, pixel-art craftsmanship, palette, lighting and Santiago atmosphere. Match that exact black street dog with one naturally upright and one folded ear, a long rounded gray-blue shaded canine muzzle, amber eye, short black fur with rich slate highlights, and a vivid folded red bandana tied at the back. This must be a new medal-award scene in the same premium pixel-art style.
Composition: wide landscape 3:2 illustration, designed to remain legible when reduced to 160x96 native pixels. An intimate, celebratory medium close-up: Matapacos sits proudly in the LEFT foreground, looking right and slightly up at the president, his head and chest large and shaded. The president kneels in the RIGHT foreground at the dog's height, smiling warmly, gently placing a conspicuous round GOLD MEDAL on a ribbon over the dog's red bandana. The president's hands, the ribbon and medal, and the dog's neck are fully visible near the CENTER, in the upper 80 percent of the canvas. The medal must be large and unambiguously recognizable at native resolution, a gold disk roughly 6 native pixels across with a bright engraved center and ochre rim. Give the dog a relaxed happy expression and the president a caring expression.
President: timeless FICTIONAL Chilean president, a dignified older adult man with short graying hair, a navy formal suit, cream shirt and Chilean red-white-blue diagonal presidential sash. No likeness of a named real politician. Clear natural hands and face, strong silhouettes.
Background: the warm pale stone two-story neoclassical facade and central entrance of La Moneda, textured courtyard paving, reunited student friends together applauding in the middle distance, a few waving correct Chilean flags with blue canton/single white star, white upper stripe, red lower stripe. A small raised Chilean presidential standard above the palace, a national flag with a simplified coat of arms in its center. Santiago roofs and distant peach Andes under warm cream-gold sunset clouds. Calm and hopeful victory scene.
Craftsmanship: deliberate crisp square pixel clusters, beautiful gray-blue fur shading and texture, vivid red fabric folds, gold medal highlights, suit folds, masonry detail, layered architectural depth and warm sunset edge light. Deep navy shadows, slate fur highlights, cream-peach sky, muted teal distant city, golden stone. Like a lovingly crafted premium late-1990s handheld cutscene. A few large readable forms with purposeful detail; do not use noisy micro-stippling. Avoid geometric fox ears, stick people, flat icons, generic rectangles, vector look, blur, antialiasing, photography and 3D render.
Output: one finished illustration fills the canvas. Keep the medal and BOTH faces well within the upper 80 percent, with comfortable edges so a small bottom speech bubble won't cover the awarding gesture. Absolutely NO lettering, no titles, no 'The End', no words, no speech balloons, no UI, no borders, no watermarks or signatures. The actual game will add localized 'THE END / FIN' and the president's thanks.
